t: This is the Bazalgette Memorial on the Victoria Embankment, a few feet up river from Hungerford Bridge and the Golden Jubilee Bridges, opposite the junction with Northumberland Avenue. It honours the Victorian engineer Sir Joseph Bazalgette, and the sculptor was George Blackall Simonds. Bazalgette was Chief Engineer of the Metropolitan Board of Works, and after the Great Stink of 1858 he created London's main drainage system. It helped relieve the city of cholera epidemics and began cleaning the Thames.
